implementation.S57: The benchmark now validates an exact 24-profile/2,000-task fixture and owner/company/team/assignment/dependency references; waits for route-specific content and two animation frames; performs two warm-up cycles and ten measured cycles across analytics, tasks and overview; computes finite nearest-rank p95 and fails at >=1,000 ms, bad fixture, JavaScript errors or operational API calls. It records machine, browser, samples, source hash and a JSON report on failure or success in a unique output directory.
implementation.S58: The isolated runner uses current exact test names, excludes the historical tmp mirror, starts a separate Vitest process per expected test, reads the JSON reporter, and rejects null process status, nonzero exit, missing/zero passed tests, all-skipped results, missing/ambiguous expected pattern, or a failed expected assertion. It records executed/passed/skipped/failed counts, command, process outcome and effective-tree hash. Each run has a timestamp/PID output directory; prior outputs are never overwritten.
